ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory enhanced due diligence screening of all UBOs, directors, and authorized signatories against the UN Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) List, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions List, UK HM Treasury Consolidated List, Samoa domestic sanctions/designations, and SIFA and FIU watchlists; automated PEP identification for domestic and foreign politically exposed persons, including family members and close associates; mandatory adverse-media and enforcement-database checks; results must be evidenced in writing, retained for not less than five (5) years under Part 6 of the AMLCFT Act 2018, and escalated to the Samoa FIU for any red flag or name match.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Samoa International Financial Authority (SIFA) Name Clearance Console (online access exclusively through SIFA-licensed Registered Agents; official registry domain sifa.ws)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The statutory company name must be registered in English using Latin script only, must not be identical or misleadingly similar to any name on the SIFA register or the domestic Companies Act 2001 register, and must end with an approved limited-liability suffix such as 'Limited', 'Ltd.', 'Corporation', 'Incorporated', 'Inc.', or 'Société Anonyme'/'S.A.'; non-Roman characters are not permitted in the statutory name; a Chinese or other language trading name may be lodged only as a transliterated alias through the licensed registered agent and recorded by SIFA as a non-statutory alternate name.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Samoa (when used with a connotation of state patronage or official connection)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon SIFA preliminary refusal of a name, the licensed registered agent may file a Request for Name Reconsideration within fourteen (14) calendar days, attaching market evidence and legal argument distinguishing the proposed name from existing registrations; the reservation window is automatically extended by fifteen (15) days pending reconsideration. If SIFA upholds the refusal, the applicant may file an administrative appeal to the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour within twenty-one (21) days of the reconsideration decision, and thereafter apply for judicial review before the Supreme Court of Samoa under the Judicature Ordinance 1961. All appeal filings must be made through the registered agent and accompanied by the applicable SIFA administrative fees.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible only through a SIFA-licensed Registered Agent maintaining a physical registered office in Samoa; the International Company's registered office is the office of the licensed agent, and a standalone virtual address without a licensed agent is invalid; no client-owned premises, staff, or physical trading facility is required for an ISIC 3240 trading-card publishing vehicle, and the commercial substance requirement is satisfied by the licensed agent's in-country presence.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low; quantified annual probability below 5% for a non-licensed, non-banking International Company engaged in collectible trading-card publishing; unannounced on-site inspections occur mainly at the licensed registered agent's office in Apia under FIU supervision and are triggered by CDD deficiencies, adverse intelligence, or sanctions/PEP hits rather than by standard incorporation monitoring.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act 1987 (as consolidated and amended), ss. 6-12 (Incorporation), s. 8 (Registered Office and Agent), ss. 29-32 (Shares and Capital), s. 87 (Officers)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA), Apia, Samoa
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Application for Incorporation and Request for Certificate of Incorporation (Form IC-1), together with the executed Memorandum of Association and Articles of Association
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital. Authorized capital may be as low as one share of no par value; issued shares may be fully unpaid. No escrow or state deposit account is required under the International Companies Act 1987.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the subscribers named in the Memorandum of Association hereby subscribe for the initial allotment of ordinary shares, credited as fully paid, in accordance with the Articles of Association; RESOLVED FURTHER, that the registered office of the Company shall be fixed at the Registered Agent's address in Apia, Samoa, and that the Registered Agent is retained on the approved terms; RESOLVED FURTHER, that the named nominees be and are hereby appointed Director, Company Secretary, and Principal Officer, each holding office until the next annual general meeting or until earlier removal; RESOLVED FINALLY, that the Officers are authorized to pay all incorporation fees, open bank accounts, and perfect all statutory filings.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Finance Authority (SIFA), Apia
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit a name reservation application through a SIFA-licensed Registered Agent. Confirm the proposed corporate name ends with 'Limited', 'Corporation', 'Inc.', or the Samoan statutory equivalent, and verify the absence of conflict with existing registered names and prohibited terms under the International Companies Act 1987.
required_dossiers: Letter of engagement from the Licensed Registered Agent
Identity documents of proposed shareholders and ultimate beneficial owners for due diligence
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the proposed name is refused for similarity or prohibited terms, file an alternate name or submit the written consent of the prior registrant within 14 days; the Registry will expedite the re-check without an additional fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Preparation and Execution of Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed Registered Agent (SIFA-licensed) and Notary Public, Samoa
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association in English. Each subscriber executes the documents before a notary public or a witness qualified under the International Companies Act 1987. The Registered Agent certifies that the formation documents comply with the Act and the SIFA practice directions.
required_dossiers: Consent to act as Director, Company Secretary, and Principal Officer
Certified passport copies of all subscribers and proposed officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registry queries signature validity or capacity, arrange re-execution before a Samoan notary or obtain an apostilled notarial certificate; resubmit within 7 days of the query.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Incorporation Application with SIFA
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Finance Authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Licensed Registered Agent files Form IC-1 together with the executed constitutional documents and the prescribed government fee. The application must state the subscribers, the registered office address in Samoa, the class and maximum number of shares authorized, and the first directors and officers of the Company.
required_dossiers: Two certified copies of the Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the application is queried for defective dossiers, the Registered Agent files an amendment or a clarificatory affidavit within 10 working days; resubmission is automatic and no penalty is assessed if the original fee has been paid.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation and Corporate Book
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Finance Authority
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon satisfaction of the Act, the Registrar issues the Certificate of Incorporation. The Registered Agent then prepares the corporate minute book, share ledger, and share certificates in original form and delivers them to the directors.
required_dossiers: Certificate of Incorporation issued by the Registrar
Corporate minute book and share register
Company seal (optional under the International Companies Act 1987)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Any discrepancy in the legal name, date, or registration number is corrected by filing the Registry's rectification form at no additional State fee; a corrected Certificate is issued within 5 working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: First Board Meeting and Post-Incorporation Governance Filings
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company Board of Directors and Licensed Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting (physically or by written resolution) to allot shares, appoint officers, confirm the registered office and Registered Agent, and open the corporate bank account. Complete any beneficial ownership particulars required under the International Companies Act 1987 and SIFA economic substance practice, if activated.
required_dossiers: First Board Resolutions or unanimous written consents
Corporate bank account opening file (Certificate of Incorporation, board resolution, director identities)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the corporate bank queries the file, provide a notarized Certificate of Good Standing from the Registrar and a board-certified extract of the resolutions within 7 days to cure the deficiency.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Not applicable for a non-resident International Company operating outside Samoa; if a physical Samoan production facility were ever established, the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) and SIFA would exercise concurrent jurisdiction over the industrial licence.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: None required for offshore trading-card publishing and cold-foil printing services conducted outside Samoa under the International Companies Act 1987; any domestic manufacturing within Samoa would require a Trade and Manufacturing Business Licence issued by MCIL.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environment Division, Ministry of Natural Resources and Environment (MNRE), Samoa
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — the offshore International Company has no Samoan-based operations or discharges; an EIA Registration would apply only to a future local printing facility under the Environment Act 1989 and the Water Resources Management Act 2008.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: If a local plant were later licensed: zero untreated wastewater discharge; solvent and VOC emissions from gravure inks and cold-foil adhesives must meet ambient air quality guidelines; all waste inks, foil matrix scrap, and solvent-contaminated materials require documented removal by an MNRE-licensed waste carrier.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Not mandated for the offshore International Company structure. Were a domestic facility established, the following clearances would apply: fire safety certification from the Samoa Fire and Emergency Services Authority (FESA); structural load certification for printing and foil-stamping machinery from the Ministry of Works, Transport and Infrastructure; and occupational health and workplace clearance under the Labour and Employment Relations Act 2013 administered by MCIL.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Ministry of Revenue of the Government of Samoa, Level 2, Fatu o Le Atua Building, Apia; taxpayer portal, online forms and eVAGST services via https://www.revenue.gov.ws
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: A foreign entity electing Samoa International Company (IC) status under the International Companies Act 1987 is first incorporated by the Registrar of Companies and thereafter receives an International Company Certificate. Because the IC is structured as a tax-exempt, non-resident company, no income tax TIN is required for the IC's offshore operations. If the IC makes taxable supplies in Samoa or voluntarily registers for VAGST, it must submit Form VAGST-R to the Ministry of Revenue; upon approval and issuance of a VAGST registration number, that VAT ID becomes the IC's domestic indirect tax identifier.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None available. A Samoa International Company is statutorily exempt from income tax under the International Companies Act 1987 and the Income Tax Ordinance 1959; Samoa does not operate a US-style check-the-box election, and no hybrid mismatch or deemed taxation election is available. The IC may, for administrative purposes, elect to be treated as a non-resident entity by the Ministry of Revenue, but such election has no effect on its underlying tax-exempt status.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Goods and Services Tax (VAGST)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: WST 80,000 (Samoa tala) of taxable supplies in any consecutive twelve-month period; voluntary registration is available for exporters such as a collectible trading card publisher that intends to zero-rate offshore sales.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Samoa does not currently mandate real-time fiscal clearance, API-integrated e-invoicing, or digital stamping for VAGST invoices. A registered person must issue full VAGST tax invoices in sequential order using an approved invoice format that contains prescribed particulars. For export supplies, zero-rated commercial invoices must be issued with the export invoice wording and the IC's VAGST registration number; no government e-approval or digital stamping API is applied.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: A Samoa International Company registered for VAGST may claim zero-rating on tangible goods such as collectible trading cards if the card supply is an export from Samoa, ownership of the goods passes to an overseas buyer, and the goods are physically delivered outside Samoa within 28 days (or within a longer period authorized by the Ministry of Revenue) of the supply. Services that are supplied directly in connection with land or goods located outside Samoa, or supplied to and enjoyed by a non-resident, may also be zero-rated. The exporter must retain contemporaneous documentary evidence of export and receipt of foreign sales consideration.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or Air Waybill
Inward Remittance Certificate / Bank Payment Justification / Foreign Currency Remittance Slip
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The Samoa Ministry of Revenue may retrospectively audit export zero-rating claims for six years. If the factual export and foreign payment conditions are not substantiated, the claimed zero rate is replaced by the 15% VAGST rate on the full invoice value, input credits originally attributed to the claimed export are clawed back, and late payment interest accrues from the original filing date. Fraudulent or negligent export VAT schemes on collectible trading cards expose the IC and its officers to civil penalties of up to 100% of tax evaded, monetary fines up to WST 100,000, deregistration of the IC, invalidation of the International Company certificate, and in aggravated cases criminal imprisonment under Samoa's Crimes Act and the Tax Administration Act.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Samoa (Faletupe Tutotonu o Samoa), which administers the national exchange-control regime under the Exchange Control Act 1973 and issues delegated instructions to licensed authorized dealers
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Samoan Tala (WST) is a managed-float currency pegged to a trade-weighted basket, with onshore convertibility available only through CBS-licensed authorized dealers. Current-account transactions are broadly liberalized, but capital-account movements, including equity injections, dividend repatriation, and derivative transactions, remain subject to exchange-control approval or express CBS delegation to authorized dealers. A Samoa International Company (IC) can achieve near-total de facto convertibility by maintaining a USD Foreign Currency Account (FCA), denominating all trading, disbursement, and settlement flows in USD, and avoiding WST conversion except for local statutory agent fees and compliance disbursements. Profit remittances funded entirely from USD FCA balances do not enter the WST conversion queue; dividend remittances require supporting board resolutions, source documentation, and, where applicable, a tax-clearance certificate from the Samoa Ministry for Revenue. The principal residual hurdle is the absence of a deep offshore deliverable WST market, making any hedging reliant on offshore non-deliverable contracts.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Under CBS Exchange Control notices, export proceeds in foreign currency must be repatriated to and lodged with an authorized dealer in Samoa within six months of the date of export, supported by shipping and customs documentation such as the air waybill, bill of lading, or electronic export entry. There is no mandatory percentage conversion into WST: 100 percent of documented export proceeds may be retained in an approved USD Foreign Currency Account provided the authorized dealer records settlement on the prescribed CBS foreign-exchange return. Where conversion into WST is elected, the full amount must be sold through the authorized dealer at the prevailing spot rate; private or offshore conversion through unlicensed intermediaries is prohibited.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: USD Foreign Currency Account (FCA) designated as the primary treasury settlement and escrow ledger
USD FCA primary operating account with WST sub-ledger for agent fees and statutory compliance payments
WST domestic operating account with USD overlay for trade settlements

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Rating: LOW as a Samoa-domiciled settlement layer; MEDIUM as an offshore collection rail only. Samoa has no regulatory category for electronic money institutions, and payment-service provision is reserved for CBS-licensed banks and financial institutions. An offshore EMI account may be used to receive Stripe and Authorize.Net settlement flows before onward transfer to the Samoan USD FCA, but it must never be represented as a bank, hold Samoa-regulated treasury balances, or serve as a mechanism to bypass exchange-control recording. Any such misrepresentation would constitute an automatic KYC failure and regulatory red flag.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical attendance by all directors is not a statutory mandate under the International Companies Act 1987, and offshore directorates are expressly permitted. However, CBS-licensed banks implementing the Money Laundering Prevention Act 2007 require a verifiable identity step: either at least one fully authorized director or signatory attends an in-person or compliant video interview with the bank's compliance officer, or the Samoa-licensed corporate registered agent certifies the complete CDD file under an approved introduced-business protocol. Fully remote account opening is possible only where the bank pre-approves the introducer jurisdiction, the CDD file is certified by the registered agent, and original or notarized identity documents are lodged.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial ownership resolved to a Chinese-language family trust with no definitive English instrument and no clear individual economic-interest disclosure.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Certified English translation of the trust deed and supplementary trust letters; the current beneficial-ownership register of the Samoa IC countersigned by the registered agent; a trust board resolution segregating the IC from unrelated trust assets; passport copies of all trustee directors and every settlor or beneficiary holding more than 10 percent of the distributable interest.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: E-commerce trading-card revenue is fully digital, geographically dispersed, and lacks a customs or shipment trace relevant to the physical holographic cold-foil printing business.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Stripe and Authorize.Net merchant settlement reports and platform underwriting approvals; a physical shipment ledger keyed to each card serial number; air waybills and Samoa Customs export entries filed through the Ministry for Revenue; production orders from foil and substrate contractors; an external audit report reconciling digital revenue against shipped units.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Third-party payments received from individual collectors, family members, or associated trusts outside the merchant's own settlement accounts.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: A closed-loop payment policy requiring all inbound funds to originate from machine-verified customer accounts; a transaction-monitoring dashboard and case-file notes for each flagged deposit; a documented refund, dispute, and chargeback workflow; and a 12-month bank statement demonstrating the legitimate clearing of all identified one-off remitters.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Use of the Samoa-licensed registered agent as co-signatory to the bank account raises perceived nominee misuse or lack of genuine commercial activity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: The IC board resolution appointing the registered agent as transactional co-signatory only; the Ministry for Revenue tax-exempt IC certificate; evidence of physical corporate existence including the Apia registered office, lease or mail-forwarding use, and registered-agent attestation; and the audited annual accounts mandate with a licensed Samoa auditor.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inward shareholder capital injections must be delivered via bank-to-bank SWIFT MT103 to the designated USD Foreign Currency Account at the Samoa authorized dealer, identifying the IC by its full registered name and account reference. The remittance information field should carry a CBS-compatible purpose descriptor pre-agreed with the receiving dealer, such as 'INVST-G1100 Equity injection of International Company,' with the beneficiary reference 'WS_IC / ISIC_3240' for reconciliation. Each injection requires the shareholder allotment resolution, the issued shares register, and the Ministry for Revenue tax-exemption certificate; the authorized dealer records the credit on the prescribed exchange-control return, and injections exceeding delegated dealer limits require prior CBS approval. Cash, cryptocurrency, or unlicensed third-party EMI pass-throughs are not acceptable channels for capital injection.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Operational disbursements for raw materials, holographic cold-foil stock, inks, laminates, packaging, and logistics use two clearing rails. Open-account SWIFT MT103 payments with unique end-to-end transaction references are used for smaller vendor settlements below US$50,000, including sample pre-payments and routine material deposits. Larger input purchases are settled by irrevocable sight or usance Commercial Letters of Credit issued under ICC UCP600 by ANZ or BSP and confirmed by a Singapore or Hong Kong correspondent bank, against presentation of the commercial invoice, full-set clean on-board transport document, packing list, and mill or foil-quality inspection certificate. The standard disbursement structure is 30 percent telegraphic-transfer deposit and 70 percent at-sight under the Letter of Credit. Receivables from the trading-card platform settle via Stripe and Authorize.Net into the same USD FCA, producing structural liquidity netting in USD with minimal WST conversion.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Deliverable WST/USD forward contract with a CBS-licensed authorized dealer for documented commercial and working-capital exposures, generally with tenors up to 12 months and subject to the bank's credit line.

Offshore non-deliverable WST/USD forward contracted by the offshore parent or trust treasury rather than by the Samoa IC itself, arranged through an international bank quoting the WSNDF, supported by board-approved hedge-test documentation; direct contracting by the Samoa IC would require prior CBS exchange-control approval.

USD-neutral cross-currency swap (USD against AUD or NZD) arranged with an international bank licensed under Samoa's International Banking Act, used exclusively to hedge input-procurement and freight currency mismatches against a USD-denominated treasury ledger.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Return (IC Form AR) with current register details and shareholder confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Financial Authority (SIFA)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 90 days after the anniversary date of incorporation; no extension of filing window
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing penalty of USD 100 per month or part thereof; persistent default for 6 months triggers administrative strike-off under the International Companies Act 2012

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government Renewal Fee (permitted capital band up to USD 1,000,000)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Payable on the anniversary of incorporation, with a 30-day grace period before late charges accrue
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Immediate 10% surcharge on late payment; continuing default for 6 months results in strike-off and forfeiture of assets to the Government of Samoa

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Confirmation of Registered Agent and Registered Office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of International Companies, Samoa International Financial Authority (SIFA)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Filed simultaneously with the Annual Return; no separate deadline
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain a licensed registered agent for 60 consecutive days constitutes grounds for involuntary dissolution

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit required only if the International Company's gross annual turnover exceeds WST 100,000 (approximately USD 37,000) or total assets exceed WST 50,000 (approximately USD 18,500); otherwise audit-exempt with director-prepared financial statements
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS) or IFRS for Small and Medium-sized Entities as adopted by Samoa; exempt companies may maintain simplified internal accounts

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: No standalone UBO annual return is required; beneficial ownership information is refreshed in the Annual Return. Any transfer of shares or change in beneficial ownership must be recorded in the register of members and disclosed to the registered agent within 14 days, with annual confirmation of unchanged UBO details submitted to SIFA as part of the Anniversary Return.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 1,200 - 2,500 per year depending on provider and authorized capital
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 1,500 - 4,500 for a full IFRS-compliant audit; waived for audit-exempt entities

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: 0% effective corporate income tax for a Samoa International Company (IC) in the statutory tax-exempt zone. The IC is exempt from Samoan income tax on international business profits, exempt from dividend withholding tax on distributions to non-resident shareholders, exempt from capital gains tax and stamp duty on IC instruments, and instead pays only the annual government fee and files the IC annual return.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form IC-AR (Annual Return of an International Company), filed with the Registrar of International Companies through the Samoa Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Labour (MCIL) offshore registry e-services portal. An exempt IC does not file a corporate income tax return.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due within 90 days after the anniversary of incorporation or, if the company records a different annual general meeting date, within 90 days after the AGM. The annual government fee is due on the same date.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registration number, legal name, date of incorporation, and IC status confirmation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter the Samoa IC registration number exactly as issued by the Registrar. A non-resident owner does not require a Samoan Tax Identification Number unless the entity later derives Samoan-source domestic income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section B — Registered Agent and Registered Office
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and Samoa street address of the licensed registered agent and the registered office.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Provide the local agent’s physical address and service of process details. Non-resident directors may not replace the Samoa registered agent requirement.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Full legal names, residential addresses, passport numbers, and director/secretary status.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident natural persons may serve as directors; however, at least one director or secretary must satisfy statute and corporate registry requirements and the company must maintain a natural-person officer for AML and registry contact purposes.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section D — Shareholders and Ultimate Beneficial Owner Register
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Shareholder names, share class, share count, and ultimate beneficial ownership details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose the final natural-person beneficial owner of the collectible trading-card publishing entity. Nominee shareholders must be identified and accompanied by UBO declarations.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: ISIC / NAICS code and narrative description of the company’s business.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Enter ISIC 3240 — Manufacture of games and toys, specifically security holographic cold-foil printing of collectible trading cards. Confirm that all substantive activity is conducted outside Samoa unless an exemption has been breached.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration that the IC has not carried on domestic Samoan business under the International Companies Act.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If any revenue has been derived from Samoan domestic customers, the IC may lose its exempt status and become liable to standard Samoan income tax at 27%.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing of the IC-AR triggers a prescribed late filing penalty plus daily surcharge, automatic accrual of interest on the unpaid annual government fee, and registry strike-off proceedings after continued default. Directors may be disqualified, and the IC loses good-standing status needed to maintain Stripe, Authorize.Net, and correspondent banking relationships.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Standard Samoa Company Income Tax Return, filed through the Samoa Revenue Authority (SRA) online taxpayer portal. Required only for an ordinary resident Samoan company or in the exceptional case where an International Company has lost its exemption by deriving Samoan-source domestic income.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due on or before the last day of the sixth month after the company’s balance date. An exempt IC is not required to file unless SRA issues a direction or the IC has breached the domestic business prohibition.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name, Tax Identification Number, registered address, financial year-end, and country of incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident IC should only obtain a TIN and file after SRA has confirmed that the exemption does not apply. Otherwise the filing itself may create unintended Samoa tax nexus.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross worldwide or Samoa-source income, depending on SRA assessment basis.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Exclude exempt international trading-card publishing revenue. Include any non-exempt revenue from Samoan customers or Samoan-situated assets.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Cost of sales, security foil printing costs, holographic substrate, card stock, shipping, merchant processing fees, and general administration expenses.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Expenses must be ordinary and necessary and supported by contemporaneous documentation. Related-party supplies of holographic cold-foil printing services must be priced at arm’s length.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Prior-year tax losses carried forward and applied in the current year.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Samoa permits a maximum carryforward period of 5 years for taxable companies. An exempt IC cannot carry forward a tax loss because it derives no taxable income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Computation of corporate income tax on adjusted taxable income.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No tax is payable by an exempt IC. If the IC has lost exemption, tax is payable at 27% and directors may become personally liable for knowingly permitting the non-compliant domestic trade.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Box 6 — Foreign Tax Credits and Withholding Credits
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Credits for foreign tax paid and withholding tax suffered.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident shareholder may not claim Samoan tax credits on exempt IC dividends. The IC should attach evidence of any foreign tax paid if foreign tax credits are claimed on non-exempt income.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing and late payment penalties are assessed by SRA under the Tax Administration Act, including daily default interest on unpaid tax, a percentage-based late filing surcharge, and penalty tax of up to 100% or more for deliberately false statements. Continued non-compliance exposes directors to personal assessment and enforcement restrictions.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% for dividends paid by an International Company to non-resident shareholders because IC distributions are exempt under the Samoan offshore regime. The standard statutory dividend withholding tax rate for an ordinary resident Samoan company is 15%, reduced to 5%–15% under an applicable double taxation agreement.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: For an exempt IC dividend, no treaty relief protocol is required because the domestic IC exemption already produces a 0% rate. For ordinary resident Samoan companies, the beneficial owner must submit a valid Certificate of Residence (TRC) and the prescribed Samoa Revenue Authority treaty claim form to SRA before the dividend is remitted, or the standard 15% rate applies. Treaty relief is denied where the recipient is a nominee, conduit, or does not have beneficial ownership of the shares.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Standard statutory non-resident withholding tax rates on Samoa-source interest and royalties are 15% each. An International Company paying interest or royalties out of exempt international business is not generally subject to Samoa withholding tax. Under Samoa’s double tax treaties with Australia and New Zealand, interest and royalties may be reduced to 10% after TRC and advance clearance; China and Hong Kong residents have no DTA reduction, so the default statutory rate applies where the income is not otherwise exempt.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No separate statutory Local File or Master File threshold is fixed in WST under Samoa domestic law. Transfer pricing documentation is required whenever a related-party transaction is material to the taxpayer’s position and is not priced on an arm’s length basis. Samoa follows the OECD Transfer Pricing Guidelines in applying the arm’s length standard through the Income Tax Act.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The Samoa International Companies regime is subject to economic substance oversight. An International Company engaged in ISIC 3240 collectible trading-card publishing must demonstrate genuine commercial substance: licensed registered agent in Samoa, recorded board and management decisions, physical place of business, employees or contractors with adequate qualifications, and real activities such as contract negotiation, IP ownership, licensing, printing supervision, and merchant settlement control. A letterbox company or shell IC with no substance may be struck off, have its exemption revoked, and be taxed as a resident Samoan company.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using a Samoan International Company as a tax-evasion vehicle to shelter collectible trading-card profits while the real senior management, holographic cold-foil printing operations, creative control, and economic decision-making remain in the shareholder’s home jurisdiction, followed by failure to disclose the true beneficial owner or to report income in the residence country.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Prosecution under Samoa criminal and tax administration statutes; penalty tax of up to 200% of the evaded tax; confiscation of the IC’s bank accounts, card inventory, and printing receivables; corporate fine up to WST 1 million; SRA may recharacterize the IC as a resident Samoan company and assess tax at 27% on the entire undeclared profit stream.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Courts may pierce the corporate veil where directors personally directed the evasion. Directors and shadow directors are jointly and severally liable for the company’s unpaid tax and penalties, and face imprisonment up to 14 years, civil restitution orders, passport surrender, and travel bans pending final tax clearance.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Maintaining a Samoa International Company with no physical office, no local agent activity, no board meetings, no staffing, and no genuine decision-making outside the owner’s jurisdiction, solely to collect Stripe and Authorize.Net merchant revenues and avoid proper taxation on security holographic cold-foil trading-card sales.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Registrar strike-off and dissolution; cancellation of international company status; retrospective loss of the tax-exempt zone; SRA may tax the shell company at 27% and deny deductions that cannot be substantiated; public strike-off notices disqualify the entity from banking, payment processor, and distributor agreements.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the licensed registered agent who signed declarations knowing the entity lacked substance are personally liable for restoration costs, regulatory penalties, and unpaid annual government fees. A director may be barred from managing any Samoa company for up to 5 years and restrained from leaving Samoa without SRA or court authorization.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using a low-risk collectible-trading-card publishing IC to layer payments between Samoa, Hong Kong, and other jurisdictions, commingling merchant receipts with unrelated crypto or cash proceeds, using nominee shareholders without UBO disclosure, or failing to report suspicious transactions from high-volume online card sales.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Corporate fines up to WST 5 million under Samoa AML/CFT legislation; asset forfeiture and freezing of merchant accounts; revocation of the registered agent’s license; referral of directors and beneficial owners to foreign tax and law enforcement authorities through the Samoa Financial Intelligence Unit.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors, AML compliance officers, and beneficial owners face personal criminal liability with imprisonment up to 10 years; regulatory travel bans, property restraint orders, and personal monetary penalties are available, and directors cannot rely on the company’s legal personality to shield proceeds obtained through deliberate AML breaches.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Withholding Tax Evasion and Exemption Overreach
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Misclassifying distributions as exempt IC dividends when the payer is actually an ordinary Samoan resident company, or claiming International Company exemption on income derived from Samoan domestic trading-card sales, or routing royalties from Chinese and Hong Kong owners through Samoa without proper withholding and substance.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: SRA will assess non-resident withholding tax at 15% on the misclassified dividends, interest, or royalties, add penalties of up to 100% of the underpaid amount, and recover unpaid withholding tax from the company plus daily statutory interest. The IC exemption is treated as void from inception.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly caused the company to make exempt distributions without satisfying the International Company conditions are personally liable for the unpaid withholding tax and penalties. Courts may issue asset forfeiture orders, travel bans, and civil recovery judgments against directors to enforce collection.
